levels.effect: Your melee attacks with a lightsaber inflict +1 damage. When parrying a blaster bolt, you may make an immediate counter-attack with the deflected bolt at a -5 skill penalty (uses a regular attack action).

conditional.when: on melee attacks with a lightsaber

levels.effect: Your melee attacks with a lightsaber inflict +2 damage. When parrying a blaster bolt, you may make an immediate counter-attack with the deflected bolt at a -3 skill penalty. If you successfully parry a melee attack, your next counter-attack against that opponent this turn gains a +1 skill bonus.

conditional.when: on melee attacks with a lightsaber
on your next counter-attack against that opponent, after a successful melee Parry

If you successfully parry a melee attack, your next counter-attack against that opponent this turn gains a +2 skill bonus. You gain a +1 bonus to your Feint skill rolls.

levels.effect: Your melee attacks with a lightsaber inflict +4 damage. When parrying a blaster bolt, you may make an immediate counter-attack with the deflected bolt at no skill penalty. If you successfully parry a melee attack, your next counter-attack against that opponent this turn gains a +3 skill bonus. You gain a +2 bonus to your Feint skill rolls, and your melee attacks can ignore 1 point of the target's DR on a successful hit by 3 or more.
